blocks.text: So'zlashuvda, do'stlarga yozilgan xabarlarda va oddiy xatlarda **be**, **have**, **will**, **would**, **had** va **not** deyarli doim qisqartiriladi: I am → I**'m**, they have → they**'ve**, do not → do**n't**. Apostrof (`'`) tushib qolgan harf(lar) o'rnida turadi: I **a**m → I'm, do n**o**t → don't. O'zbek tilida ham og'zaki nutqda so'zlar qisqaradi (kelayapman → kelyapman), lekin inglizchada qisqa shakl yozuvda ham qat'iy qoida bilan yoziladi. To'liq shakl rasmiy xat va hujjatlarda hamda so'zga urg'u berilganda ishlatiladi.

Jadvalda ikki shakl ikki xil ma'noga ega: **'s** — is yoki has, **'d** — would yoki had. Qaysi biri ekanini keyingi so'z ko'rsatadi (pastda). Qisqa shakl faqat olmoshdan emas, ism, ot, so'roq so'zi va **there / that / here** dan keyin ham keladi:

rows: Who's that? / Who's seen my keys?

items.text: **I'll** call you when I get home.

blocks.text: **not** qisqarib **n't** bo'ladi va oldingi yordamchi yoki modal fe'lga qo'shilib yoziladi: is not → is**n't**, do not → do**n't**. Uchta alohida shaklni eslab qoling: will not → **won't** («willn't» emas), cannot → **can't**, shall not → **shan't** (kam ishlatiladi). **am not** ning n't shakli yo'q: faqat I**'m not** («I amn't» emas); so'roqda esa Britaniyada **aren't I?** deyiladi: I'm right, **aren't I**?

**be** bilan inkorning ikki qisqa shakli bor va ikkalasi ham to'g'ri: she **isn't** = she**'s not**, they **aren't** = they**'re not**. have va will bilan ham shunday (I **haven't** = I**'ve not**, he **won't** = he**'ll not**), lekin bu yerda n't li shakl ancha ko'p ishlatiladi.

**'s** dan keyingi so'zga qarang. Keyin `-ing`, sifat, ot yoki joy kelsa — bu **is**. Keyin V3 (finished, been, gone) yoki **got** kelsa — bu **has** (Present Perfect yoki have got). Ismdan keyin **'s** va undan keyin ot kelib, gapda boshqa fe'l bo'lsa — bu umuman fe'l emas, **egalik**: Madina**'s** bag is red — Madinaning sumkasi qizil (→ 64-dars).

**'d** da ham keyingi so'z hal qiladi. Keyin V1 (like, love, go, help) kelsa — bu **would**: I**'d** like..., I**'d** go... Keyin V3 (finished, gone, seen) kelsa — bu **had** (Past Perfect): I**'d** finished... Ikki tayyor iborani alohida eslab qoling: **'d better** = had better («... qilganingiz ma'qul»), **'d rather** = would rather («... afzal ko'raman»).

rows: I**'d** like a cup of tea.
I**'d** help you if I could.

items.text: **I'd** love to visit Samarkand one day.
When I called, **she'd** already gone to bed.
items.translation: Men qo'ng'iroq qilganimda u allaqachon **yotib qolgan edi**.

items: Darak qisqa javob oxirida: Are you ready? — Yes, I **am**. («Yes, I'm.» emas.) Has she called? — Yes, she **has**. Inkor qisqa shakli esa bemalol: No, I**'m not**. No, she **hasn't**. (→ 41-dars)
Gap oxirida **is / am / have** qisqarmaydi: Do you know where he **is**? («where he's?» emas.)
So'zga urg'u berilganda: I **am** listening! — Eshityapman-ku!
Rasmiy xat, ariza, hujjat va ilmiy matnda — to'liq shakl: I **am** writing to apply for...

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari — talaffuzi bir xil so'zlarni chalkashtirish: **it's** (= it is) va **its** («uning»); **you're** (= you are) va **your** («sizning»); **they're** (= they are), **their** («ularning») va **there** («u yerda»); **who's** (= who is) va **whose** («kimning»). Yana: «I amn't» → I**'m not**; «Yes, I'm.» → Yes, I **am**.; «dont», «cant» → apostrof tushib qolmasin: do**n't**, ca**n't**; «do'nt» → apostrof `o` o'rnida: don't.

Eslab qolish: apostrof ikki so'z orasiga emas, **tushib qolgan harf** o'rniga qo'yiladi: has n**o**t → hasn't. **'s** va **'d** ni ajratish uchun keyingi so'zga qarang: V3 bo'lsa — **has / had**, boshqa narsa bo'lsa — **'s** = is, **'d** = would.

Bog'liq darslar: → 1-dars (I'm, she's), 9-dars (I've got), 15-dars (Present Perfect), 27-dars (I'll, won't), 34-dars (I'd like), 40–43-darslar (yordamchi fe'llar, qisqa javob va inkor), 64-dars (egalik **'s**).

examples.title: be: **I'm**, **you're**, **she's**, **they're**
examples.description: **be** ning qisqa shakllari: I'm, you're, he's / she's / it's, we're, they're; ism va so'roq so'zlardan keyin ham: Tom's, What's, Where's, Who's.

sentences.text: **I'm** from Namangan, but I live in Tashkent now.
**You're** always the first to arrive at the office.
Madina**'s** a nurse at the city hospital.
**It's** freezing outside, so take your gloves.
**We're** going to the cinema tonight — do you want to come?
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun kinoga **boryapmiz** — sen ham borasanmi?

sentences.text: **They're** staying with us for the whole of June.
**What's** the weather like in London today?
**Where's** the remote control? I can't find it anywhere.
**Who's** that tall man next to James?
sentences.translation: Jeymsning yonidagi anavi baland bo'yli kishi **kim**?

sentences.text: Tom**'s** at the gym, and Emma**'s** still asleep.

examples.title: have: **I've**, **we've**, **she's** (= has)
examples.description: **have / has** ning qisqa shakllari: I've, you've, we've, they've, he's / she's / it's (= has). Ular Present Perfect va have got da ishlatiladi.

sentences.text: **I've** just finished my homework.
**We've** lived in this flat for ten years.
**They've** never been to Scotland.
Bekzod**'s** bought a new car — a white one.
sentences.translation: Bekzod yangi mashina **sotib olibdi** — oq rangli.

sentences.text: **You've** got such a lovely garden!
**She's** got three brothers but no sisters.
sentences.translation: Uning uchta aka-ukasi **bor**, lekin opa-singlisi yo'q.

sentences.text: **It's** stopped snowing, so the children have run outside.
sentences.translation: Qor **to'xtadi**, shuning uchun bolalar tashqariga yugurib chiqishdi.

sentences.text: **Who's** taken my charger? It was here a minute ago.
sentences.translation: Zaryadlovchimni kim **olib qo'ydi**? Bir daqiqa oldin shu yerda edi.

sentences.text: Sarah**'s** worked in Manchester since 2019.
**What's** happened? You look really worried.

examples.title: will: **I'll**, **it'll**, **won't**
examples.description: **will** ning qisqa shakli — **'ll** (I'll, she'll, it'll, there'll, that'll), inkori — **won't** (= will not).

sentences.text: **I'll** carry that bag for you — it looks heavy.
Come on, Madina, or **we'll** miss the beginning of the film!
sentences.translation: Qani, Madina, tezroq, aks holda filmning boshini **ko'rmay qolamiz**!

sentences.text: Take an umbrella — **it'll** probably rain this afternoon.
sentences.translation: Soyabon oling — tushdan keyin, ehtimol, yomg'ir **yog'adi**.

sentences.text: Don't worry, **you'll** pass the exam easily.
**She'll** be thirty next month.
The shop **won't** be open on New Year's Day.
My brother **won't** lend me his laptop.
**There'll** be a lot of traffic in the city centre tomorrow.
Aziz says **he'll** call us as soon as he lands in London.
sentences.translation: Aziz Londonga qo'nishi bilan bizga **qo'ng'iroq qilarkan**.

sentences.text: **That'll** be twelve pounds fifty, please.
sentences.translation: Hammasi bo'lib o'n ikki funt ellik pens **bo'ladi**.

examples.title: Negatives: **isn't**, **doesn't**, **didn't**, **can't**
examples.description: **not** → **n't**: isn't, wasn't, don't, doesn't, didn't, haven't, can't, couldn't, shouldn't, mustn't. So'roqda ham qisqa inkor ishlatiladi: **Aren't** you cold?

sentences.text: Dilnoza **doesn't** eat meat, so I made a vegetable soup.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza go'sht **yemaydi**, shuning uchun sabzavotli sho'rva qildim.

sentences.text: We **didn't** go out last night because of the storm.
**Aren't** you cold in that thin jacket?
The museum **wasn't** very interesting, to be honest.
sentences.translation: Rostini aytsam, muzey unchalik qiziq **emas edi**.

sentences.text: I **haven't** seen that film yet — please don't tell me the ending!
sentences.translation: Bu filmni hali **ko'rmadim** — iltimos, oxirini aytmang!

sentences.text: **Can't** you see I'm busy?
You **mustn't** use your phone while you're driving.
Bekzod **couldn't** sleep because the neighbours were having a party.
sentences.translation: Qo'shnilar bazm qilayotgani uchun Bekzod **uxlay olmadi**.

sentences.text: You **shouldn't** drink so much coffee in the evening.
These trousers **don't** fit me any more, and the shirt **isn't** clean.
sentences.translation: Bu shim menga endi **to'g'ri kelmaydi**, ko'ylak esa toza **emas**.

examples.title: **'s** = is or has?
examples.description: **'s** dan keyingi so'zga qarang: `-ing`, sifat, ot yoki joy kelsa — **is**; V3 yoki got kelsa — **has**. Tarjimada farq aniq ko'rinadi.

sentences.text: **He's** working from home today.
**He's** worked here for twelve years.
sentences.translation: U bu yerda o'n ikki yildan beri **ishlaydi**.

sentences.text: Emma**'s** really happy with her new job.
Emma**'s** found a flat near the river.
**It's** been a long day — I'm exhausted.
Bukhara**'s** famous for its old madrasas.
**Who's** eaten the last piece of cake?
**There's** been a problem with your booking, I'm afraid.
**She's** got a meeting at three, so **she's** leaving early.
sentences.translation: Uning soat uchda uchrashuvi **bor**, shuning uchun erta **ketyapti**.

sentences.text: **What's** your brother doing these days?

examples.title: **'d** = would or had?
examples.description: **'d** dan keyin V1 (like, love, learn) kelsa — **would**; V3 (seen, closed, paid) kelsa — **had** (Past Perfect). **'d better** = had better, **'d rather** = would rather.

sentences.text: **I'd** like a glass of water, please.
**We'd** love to come to your wedding!
**She'd** never seen the sea before her trip to Scotland.
sentences.translation: Shotlandiyaga safaridan oldin u dengizni hech qachon **ko'rmagan edi**.

sentences.text: **You'd** better take a taxi — it's late.
If I had more time, **I'd** learn Japanese.
By the time we got to the station, **they'd** closed the ticket office.
sentences.translation: Biz vokzalga yetib borganimizda kassani **yopib qo'yishgan edi**.

sentences.text: **I'd** rather stay at home tonight; I'm too tired.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun uyda **qolganim ma'qul**; juda charchaganman.

sentences.text: Tom said **he'd** already paid for the tickets.
sentences.translation: Tom chiptalar uchun allaqachon **to'lab qo'yganini** aytdi.

sentences.text: Sarah thought **it'd** be a good idea to leave early.
sentences.translation: Sara erta jo'nash yaxshi fikr **bo'ladi** deb o'yladi.

sentences.text: Aziz was hungry because **he'd** missed lunch.
sentences.translation: Aziz och edi, chunki tushlikni **o'tkazib yuborgan edi**.

examples.title: Short answers: Yes, I **am**. / No, I **haven't**.
examples.description: Dialog. Darak qisqa javob oxirida to'liq shakl keladi: Yes, I **am** / Yes, it **is** («Yes, I'm» emas). Inkor qisqa javobda esa qisqa shakl odatiy: No, I **haven't** / No, it **isn't**.

sentences.text: — **Are** you ready to leave, Emma?
— Yes, I **am**. I've packed everything.
— **Have** you got the tickets?
— No, I **haven't**. I thought you had them!
— Oh no! **Is** the printer working?
— Yes, it **is**, but there's no paper.
— **Can** we show them on the phone?
— I think we **can**. I'll check the website.
— Great. **Isn't** the taxi here yet?
— No, it **isn't**, but it's on its way.

examples.title: Mixed: short forms in everyday messages
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: do'stlar va oilaga yoziladigan xabarlardagi qisqa shakllar — be, have, will, would va **n't** birga.

sentences.text: Hi Mum, **I'm** on the train — **I'll** be home by seven.
sentences.translation: Salom, oyi, poyezd**daman** — soat yettigacha uyda **bo'laman**.

sentences.text: Sorry, **we're** stuck in traffic, so **we'll** be about twenty minutes late.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, tirbandlikda **qolib ketdik**, shuning uchun yigirma daqiqacha **kechikamiz**.

sentences.text: **Don't** forget — **it's** Grandma's birthday on Sunday!
**Haven't** you finished yet? **We're** all waiting for you.
Bekzod**'s** just called — **he's** lost his keys again.
**There's** some plov in the fridge if **you're** hungry.
**I'd** love to come, but **I've** got an exam tomorrow.
**Let's** meet outside the cinema at six — **that's** easier for everyone.
sentences.translation: Kinoteatr oldida soat oltida **uchrashaylik** — hamma uchun shunisi **qulayroq**.

sentences.text: Sarah **won't** be at the meeting because **she's** not feeling well.
sentences.translation: Sara yig'ilishda **bo'lmaydi**, chunki o'zini yaxshi **his qilmayapti**.

sentences.text: **Who's** coming to the match on Saturday? **I've** got two spare tickets.
sentences.translation: Shanba kungi o'yinga kim **boradi**? Menda ikkita ortiqcha chipta **bor**.
